title: Renormalization Group and String Loops
summary: Fixed points of the 2d renormalization group flow are known to correspond to tree level string vacua. We discuss how the renormalization group (or "sigma model") approach can be extended to the string loop level. The central role of the condition of renormalizability of the generating functional for string amplitudes with respect to both "local" and "modular" infinities is emphasized. Several one-loop and two-loop examples of renormalization are considered.
